name: BACH_0288
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and unflagged input support this [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Invasive 10% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent support |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 2, 4, 10) · context · 66% tumor nuclei, 2,836/mm²; higher than 96–97% of reference [F7, F8] · Measured
- **Nuclear size** (regions 2, 4, 10) · context · Mean 42.5 µm², lowest percentile in reference [F9] · Measured
- **Low nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Typical score; small contribution in this case · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses (0/20) are Unreliable; lymphocytes (8/20) Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion is missed: 3 of 5 most similar cases, including the closest (BACH_0138), are Invasive.
- Invasion lies outside regions 2, 4, 10, the only regions with cell measurements.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 2**: per-region invasive probability 84% versus 10% overall; confirm tumor is duct-confined.
2. **Regions 7, 3, 4**: largest contributions to the invasive logit; look for stromal invasion.
3. **Region 10**: strongest tumor-infiltrating stroma score; separate invasion from benign stroma.
